lines.en: label sanaspringbargen:
scene sanaspringbargen
When I first started coming here, I wasn't really sure what I was doing apart from the scattered yet frequent desires to fuck a small girl who {s}has{/s} had trouble speaking.
lines.zh: 刚来这儿的时候，我真不确定自己在做什么，除了那些零散却频繁的、想操一个说话费劲的小女孩的念头。

lines.en: Now, I know exactly why I take up residence on the very stool I speak to you from. I am here to forget.
lines.zh: 现在，我清楚地知道自己为什么总赖在这张我对你们说话的凳子上。我来这儿是为了遗忘。

lines.en: It's not a unique reason by any means. In fact, I imagine it's the same reason this girl and her mother remain so dedicated to the business despite its shortcomings.
lines.zh: 这理由一点也不独特。事实上，我想这个女孩和她母亲尽管生意惨淡却仍死守着它，靠的也是同一个理由。

lines.en: All of us lost someone. But it's that lingering {i}carrot-on-a-stick{/i} that maybe {i}mine{/i} will come back that makes things even worse.
lines.zh: 我们都失去了某个人。但正是那份挥之不去的、{i}挂在棍子上的胡萝卜{/i}——也许{i}我失去的那个{/i}会回来——把一切变得更糟。

lines.en: This bar and this girl are welcome distractions. The music is soothing, the atmosphere is comforting, and the alcohol is numbing.
lines.zh: 这家酒吧和这个女孩都是受欢迎的消遣。音乐舒缓，气氛惬意，酒精麻木。

lines.en: And it's even better that it's served up by someone who {s}needs{/s} wants me.
lines.zh: 而由某个{s}需要{/s}……想要我的人端上来，更是再好不过。

lines.en: scene black
I used to wonder what type of person this girl would become, but I seldom imagined what I could turn her into.
lines.zh: 我过去常好奇这个女孩会变成什么样的人，却很少想象过我能把她变成什么。

lines.en: Now, that's the first thing I think of when I look into her eyes.
lines.zh: 现在，这是我望着她的眼睛时想到的第一件事。

lines.en: She lets me see both of them now- like she wants me to take in more of her so that she can, in turn, fill herself with me.
lines.zh: 她现在让我看到它们两个——像是她想让我更多地接纳她，好让她反过来用我填满自己。

lines.en: I want to know the way her brain moves.
lines.zh: 我想知道她的脑是怎么转的。

lines.en: I want to know the way her blood flows.
lines.zh: 我想知道她的血是怎么流的。

lines.en: I want to stain the sheets in her bedroom.
lines.zh: 我想弄脏她卧室里的床单。
